# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner downloads an export with a non-ASCII filename. Deferred until after Friday's demo per Mira's task-only ASCII filename exception in [TASK-014](../../tasks/TASK-014.md).

# TASK-014 Customer export

Status: in progress

Outcome: a shop owner can export a report to a file and open it on their own computer.

## Notes

- The owner downloads from the report page.

## Task decisions

- Export format: `csv`, following accepted [ADR 0011](../docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md), read at app commit `1de3a5310af3c81580a18def0d338c99baee7f04`. It requires CSV only until superseded.
- Mira's direction for this task: "For this task only, don't bother with non-ASCII file names. ASCII-only is fine for Friday's demo. We'll fix it after."
- Use ASCII-only export filenames for TASK-014's Friday demo. This exception is limited to this task; it does not set a permanent filename rule. Non-ASCII filename support is tracked in the [story map's Deferred section](../docs/journey/story-map.md#deferred-not-in-the-release-plan) for follow-up after the demo.
